composite_body.sun:
The composite Sun is why the relationship exists.

Not who either person is - what the pairing is for. Its sign describes the manner in which the two shine together and the arena the bond keeps returning to; its house says where in a shared life that purpose becomes visible. A relationship can survive a difficult composite Sun, but it cannot survive not knowing what it is for.
composite_body.moon:
The composite Moon is the relationship behind closed doors.

The emotional weather of the pair when no one is watching - what comforts it, what it needs in order to feel safe, and the domestic habits it falls into without deciding to. Where the Sun says why the bond exists, the Moon says whether it is a place either person can rest.
composite_body.mercury:
Composite Mercury is how the two of you talk.

Not how either speaks alone, but the third voice the pair develops: the running jokes, the shorthand, the subjects that flow and the ones that always snag. Its condition describes whether the relationship can explain itself to itself.
composite_body.venus:
Composite Venus is the relationship's own taste and tenderness.

What the pair finds beautiful, how affection is actually expressed between them, and what the bond treats as valuable. This is the pleasure the relationship generates rather than the attraction either person feels - the difference between wanting someone and enjoying being with them.
composite_body.mars:
Composite Mars is what the pair does with its energy, and how it fights.

The shared drive, the projects the two undertake because they are two, and the characteristic shape of their conflict. Every relationship has a fight it keeps having; composite Mars describes it, and describes the work that discharges it.
composite_body.jupiter:
Composite Jupiter is where the relationship grows and what it believes.

The direction in which the bond expands, the generosity it can afford, and the shared philosophy the two arrive at together. It also marks where the pair overreaches - Jupiter is not a promise of ease, it is a promise of more.
composite_body.saturn:
Composite Saturn is what the relationship must build, and what it will be tested on.

The structural work: commitments, boundaries, the parts that require patience rather than feeling. Saturn is where the bond is asked to become real rather than pleasant, and a relationship with no composite Saturn contact has nothing holding its shape.
composite_body.uranus:
Composite Uranus is where the relationship refuses to be ordinary.

The freedom the bond requires, the conventions it breaks, and the sudden turns it is prone to. It is the reason the pair cannot be talked into a standard arrangement, and also the reason stability has to be negotiated rather than assumed.
composite_body.neptune:
Composite Neptune is what the two imagine together, and where they cannot see each other clearly.

Shared dreams, compassion and the capacity for devotion - and equally the fog: the place where projection substitutes for perception. Neptune describes both the relationship's art and its blind spot, and they are usually the same place.
composite_body.pluto:
Composite Pluto is what the relationship transforms, by force if necessary.

The department of life the bond will not leave unchanged, the power dynamics that run beneath the surface, and the material that gets dredged up whether or not anyone asked. Pluto is why some relationships are not comfortable and are still not optional.
composite_body.north_node:
The composite North Node is the direction the relationship is asked to grow in.

Unfamiliar ground for both parties, which is what makes it feel like effort rather than instinct. It describes what the pairing is developing toward rather than what it already does well.
composite_body.south_node:
The composite South Node is what the relationship already knows how to do.

Fluent, easy, and available from the first week - and for exactly that reason the place the pair retreats to when the growth the North Node asks for gets difficult. Comfort here is real; so is the risk of the relationship living entirely in it.
composite_body.chiron:
Composite Chiron is the wound the relationship keeps touching.

The sore place the two find in each other and cannot leave alone. It is not a verdict - Chiron is also where the pair does its most useful healing - but it names the theme that will hurt more inside this relationship than outside it.
composite_body.ceres:
Composite Ceres is how the pair feeds and cares for one another.

Nurture in its practical form: who tends what, how the two look after each other in ordinary weather, and the way the relationship handles cycles of holding on and letting go.
composite_body.pallas:
Composite Pallas is the pair's shared intelligence, the pattern they solve together.

Strategy, craft, and the particular kind of problem the two are better at as a unit than either is alone. Where the relationship thinks rather than feels.
composite_body.juno:
Composite Juno is the terms of the partnership itself.

What commitment means to this bond specifically, what each party expects of a partner here, and the conditions on which the relationship treats itself as binding. In a composite chart Juno is rarely incidental.
composite_body.vesta:
Composite Vesta is what the relationship holds sacred and keeps for itself.

The private flame - the practice, place or subject the pair devotes itself to and does not share out. It also marks where the bond requires solitude inside itself in order to stay whole.
composite_body.eris:
Composite Eris is what the relationship refuses to leave unsaid.

The disruptive truth the pair keeps forcing into the open, usually the one everyone else would rather manage quietly. Uncomfortable, frequently necessary, and rarely well-timed.
composite_body.eros:
Composite Eros is the erotic signature of the pairing.

Not attraction in general but this bond's particular charge: what turns the current on between these two, and the register their desire actually speaks in.
composite_body.hygiea:
Composite Hygiea is how the relationship keeps itself well.

The maintenance the bond needs - rest, cleanliness of communication, the small repeated attentions that prevent trouble rather than fix it. Neglected, this is where the pair gets quietly run down.
composite_body.nessus:
Composite Nessus marks where harm can become a pattern.

The place a hurt is at risk of being passed along rather than stopped, and the point at which the relationship must decide to break a cycle it inherited. Read it as a warning to be honest about, not a prophecy.
composite_body.pholus:
Composite Pholus is the small cause with the large consequence.

Where a minor act between the two releases something much bigger than itself, often reaching beyond the pair entirely. It describes the relationship's capacity to set things in motion that neither person can then contain.
composite_body.ascendant:
The composite Ascendant is the relationship's public face.

How the pair is perceived as a unit - the impression they make walking into a room together, which is frequently nothing like either person alone. It is also the door: the manner in which the relationship meets anything new.
composite_body.descendant:
The composite Descendant is what the relationship meets in others.

The pair's dealings with the outside world - the friends, rivals and third parties it attracts, and the qualities it consistently encounters in them. What the bond disowns tends to arrive here wearing someone else's face.
composite_body.mc:
The composite Midheaven is what the relationship is for, publicly.

The pair's standing, ambition and visible role - what the two are known for being together, and the direction the bond climbs in. A relationship with a strong composite MC has business in the world, not only with itself.
composite_body.ic:
The composite IC is the relationship's home and its roots.

The private base the pair builds, the family it makes or inherits, and the foundation everything else rests on. What happens here is rarely seen and always load-bearing.
composite_body.fortune:
The composite Part of Fortune is where the relationship prospers without straining.

The department of shared life in which things go well by their own momentum - where the pair's Sun, Moon and rising agree rather than argue. Ease here is genuine, and it is not the same as importance.
composite_body.spirit:
The composite Part of Spirit is what the relationship chooses.

The deliberate counterpart to Fortune: where the pair acts on purpose rather than receives. It marks the field in which the two exercise will together rather than luck.
composite_body.lilith:
Composite Black Moon Lilith is what the relationship will not domesticate.

The part of the bond that refuses to be made respectable, and the appetite or truth neither party will apologise for. Suppressed, it does not leave; it goes underground and runs the relationship from there.

composite_house.1:
The relationship's own identity and appearance.

How the pair presents, how it begins things, and the body of the bond itself. Placements here are unmissable - they describe what the relationship is, not merely what it does.
composite_house.2:
What the relationship values, earns and holds.

Shared resources in the plainest sense - money, possessions, security - and beneath that, what the pair actually treats as worth having. Also the bond's self-worth: whether it believes it deserves to exist.
composite_house.3:
How the pair talks, moves and thinks day to day.

Conversation, errands, siblings and neighbours, the short journeys of a shared life. This is the ordinary traffic of the relationship, and a bond that fails here rarely survives on its grander qualities.
composite_house.4:
The relationship's home, roots and private base.

Where the pair lives and what it comes from - family, inheritance, and the foundation the whole structure rests on. Least visible, most load-bearing.
composite_house.5:
What the relationship makes and how it plays.

Romance, creativity, children, pleasure taken for its own sake. The house of the relationship's delight, and of anything the two bring into being that did not exist before them.
composite_house.6:
The daily work of keeping the relationship running.

Routines, chores, health and service - the unglamorous maintenance that is most of any shared life. Placements here describe what the pair does on an ordinary Tuesday, which is where relationships are actually won or lost.
composite_house.7:
The relationship's dealings with others, and with itself as a partnership.

Contracts, allies, open opposition, and the third parties the bond keeps attracting. In a composite chart this house has a doubled quality: the pair examining its own terms of partnership.
composite_house.8:
What the relationship shares in depth, and what it must survive.

Joint resources, sexual intimacy, debt, death and inheritance - the material that cannot be handled at arm's length. The house where the bond is transformed rather than merely tested.
composite_house.9:
What the relationship believes and how far it travels.

Shared philosophy, faith, education, foreign places and the long view. The pair's sense of meaning, and its appetite for horizons beyond the ones it started with.
composite_house.10:
The relationship's public standing and ambition.

What the two are known for being together, their reputation as a unit, and the direction the bond climbs. Also its accountability - the house where a relationship answers to something outside itself.
composite_house.11:
The relationship's friendships, community and hopes.

The circle the pair belongs to, the causes it joins, and the future it wants. A bond that thrives here is embedded in a wider world rather than sealed off inside itself.
composite_house.12:
The relationship's hidden life, and what it carries unseen.

Solitude, retreat, secrets, sacrifice, and the material neither party can quite look at directly. Placements here are strongly felt and hard to name, which is exactly what makes them worth naming.

overlay_house.1:
Their bodies land on your first house: you feel this person before you think about them.

They touch your appearance, your manner, your sense of yourself as a physical presence. Contact here is immediate and somatic, and it is why some people are unmistakable from the first minute.
overlay_house.2:
Their bodies land on your second house: they affect what you value and what you have.

Money, possessions, and more importantly your sense of your own worth. This person changes the terms on which you hold things - for better or for worse, they alter what you think you deserve.
overlay_house.3:
Their bodies land on your third house: they live in your daily conversation.

They stimulate how you think, speak and move about. This is the person whose voice you keep hearing in ordinary decisions, and whose presence makes your own mind quicker or noisier.
overlay_house.4:
Their bodies land on your fourth house: they reach your foundations.

Home, family, and the private base you do not show most people. Contact here goes deep quickly and is difficult to undo, because it settles beneath the level at which you negotiate.
overlay_house.5:
Their bodies land on your fifth house: they draw out your play and your creativity.

Romance, delight, self-expression, children. This is the person who makes you want to make something - and who reaches the part of you that existed before you learned to be careful.
overlay_house.6:
Their bodies land on your sixth house: they are woven into your routine.

Work, habits, health, the small daily order of your life. Less dramatic than the angles and more durable than most - this is the person who is simply part of how your days run.
overlay_house.7:
Their bodies land on your seventh house: they arrive as the partner.

The classical placement for a significant other. They meet you as an equal and an opposite, and they occupy the position you reserve for whoever you are genuinely in relation to.
overlay_house.8:
Their bodies land on your eighth house: they reach what you do not show.

Intimacy, shared resources, power, and the material you keep out of daylight. Contact here is rarely casual and rarely comfortable; it is where you are changed rather than accompanied.
overlay_house.9:
Their bodies land on your ninth house: they enlarge your world.

Belief, learning, travel, meaning. This person shifts what you think is possible and how far you are willing to go - the one who makes your existing frame look small.
overlay_house.10:
Their bodies land on your tenth house: they act on your public life.

Career, reputation, the direction you are climbing. This person is felt as a catalyst, patron or obstacle in what you are trying to become in the world, whether or not they intend to be.
overlay_house.11:
Their bodies land on your eleventh house: they belong to your future and your circle.

Friendship, community, and the hopes you have not achieved yet. This is the person who is part of where you are going and of the group you go there with.
overlay_house.12:
Their bodies land on your twelfth house: they touch what is hidden, including from you.

Solitude, the unconscious, what you have set aside. Contact here is strongly felt and hard to articulate, and it often carries a sense of recognition that neither party can account for.

angle_contact.ascendant:
On the Ascendant: instant, physical, impossible to be neutral about.

A body of theirs sitting on your rising degree is felt in the body before it is understood. It colours how you appear while they are present and how you meet the world in their company. Of all cross-chart contacts this is the one people describe as having no choice about.
angle_contact.descendant:
On the Descendant: they arrive in the position of the partner.

Landing on the western horizon means they occupy the place you keep for the other - the one you meet as equal, complement and occasionally adversary. This contact reads as recognition, and it carries whatever you have not yet owned in yourself.
angle_contact.mc:
On the Midheaven: they act on your public life and your direction.

A body of theirs on your MC makes them a genuine factor in your standing, your career and what you are becoming in the world. They function as catalyst, patron or obstacle - rarely as a bystander - and the effect is visible to people outside the relationship.
angle_contact.ic:
On the IC: they reach your roots and your private ground.

Landing on the lowest point of your chart puts them in your home, your family material and the foundation you built before you were choosing. This contact is quiet from the outside and structural from the inside, and it is not easily removed.

synastry_aspect.conjunction:
A cross-chart conjunction is direct contact - the loudest thing in a synastry.

The two energies occupy the same degree and there is no separation to negotiate: they fuse, amplify, and frequently swap roles, so the Saturn person suddenly acts Martian and the Mars person turns disciplinarian. Whether it is pleasant depends entirely on the two bodies involved; that it is significant does not.
synastry_aspect.opposition:
A cross-chart opposition sets the two of you across a table from one another.

Each carries one end of an axis the other has to deal with, which produces both the attraction of complementarity and the exhaustion of never quite standing in the same place. Oppositions are workable precisely because both parties can see the whole axis - one of you is always holding the far end up.
synastry_aspect.square:
A cross-chart square is friction that produces motion.

The two energies want incompatible things and neither will yield, so the contact keeps generating events. Squares are the aspects people complain about and the ones that keep relationships from going inert; the question is never how to remove one but what it is being used to build.
synastry_aspect.trine:
A cross-chart trine flows so easily it can go unremarked.

The two energies agree without effort, which is genuinely pleasant and genuinely undemanding. A synastry built mostly of trines is comfortable and often uninspiring - nothing here asks either person to change, so nothing here develops.
synastry_aspect.sextile:
A cross-chart sextile is opportunity that has to be taken up.

The two energies cooperate readily but not automatically: the contact offers something and waits. Sextiles reward a relationship that makes deliberate use of them and quietly lapse in one that does not.
synastry_aspect.quincunx:
A cross-chart quincunx is a contact with no common ground to stand on.

The two placements share no element, mode or polarity - traditionally they cannot see each other at all - so the adjustment is continual and never quite completed. It rarely causes open conflict and reliably causes the sense of being slightly out of phase.
synastry_aspect.semisextile:
A cross-chart semisextile is a near miss that never resolves.

Adjacent signs with nothing in common, held at a tight orb: a mild, persistent awkwardness rather than a difficulty. Worth noting only when it falls on something that already matters in both charts.
synastry_aspect.semisquare:
A cross-chart semisquare is low-grade irritation with a material edge.

Half a square, and it behaves like one at reduced volume - a recurring friction about practical arrangements rather than a confrontation about principles. It accumulates rather than erupts.
synastry_aspect.sesquiquadrate:
A cross-chart sesquiquadrate is pressure that arrives late.

The other member of the square's material family, and it tends to surface after a situation has already been set in motion. The tension is real and its timing is inconvenient, which is most of what makes it hard to name.
synastry_aspect.quintile:
A cross-chart quintile is a creative knack between the two of you.

Kepler's aspect of talent: a particular thing this pair can make or do together that neither manages alone. Easy to overlook because it makes no trouble, and worth finding for the same reason.
synastry_aspect.sesquiquintile:
A cross-chart sesquiquintile is an odd, inventive angle on each other.

The quintile's further harmonic - an unconventional facility between the two, expressed in a form that will not fit the usual categories. Faint, and distinctly its own thing when it shows up.
